stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Request/Response Schema Validation
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, recruiting status, locations, travel metrics) to ensure contract consistency across layers.

stories.title: Clinical Trials API Endpoint Exposure via Tool Router
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search capability as an allowlisted tool through the tool_router, including input validation, routing to EvaluateCare facade, and structured response handling for LLM tool use.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Service Error Handling and Fallback Logic
stories.description: Implement robust error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes API failures, including timeouts, empty results, and partial enrichment scenarios, ensuring graceful degradation of results.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search Flow
stories.description: Develop unit tests for clinical_trials_service and integration tests covering end-to-end flow from tool invocation through facade to external API calls, including mocked ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes responses.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test file found; must create tests under backend/tests/ following existing test patterns
